name: frugalitas
description: Frugalitas: cost monitor for Claude Code — LiteLLM pay-as-you-go dollars, or token counting with API-equivalent prices and real rate limits on a Claude subscription. Status line, budget guard, /frugal report, savings tips, coins and a shop. Two modes: Frugalitas (English) and Fukarléc (Hungarian).

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: litellm: watch the LiteLLM proxy's dollars (silent elsewhere); subscription: count weighted tokens locally, for a Claude subscription; auto: litellm when the session runs through a proxy, else subscription.

sessionBudget.title: Session budget (USD)
sessionBudget.description: Budget for one Claude Code session, in dollars. 0 = none.

dailyBudget.title: Daily budget (USD)
dailyBudget.description: Daily budget in dollars (UTC day, as LiteLLM counts it). Coins and quests need one. 0 = none.

sessionTokensM.title: Subscription: session budget (M tokens)
sessionTokensM.description: Subscription mode: weighted tokens (millions) for one session. 0 = none.

windowTokensM.title: Subscription: 5-hour window budget (M tokens)
windowTokensM.description: Subscription mode: weighted tokens (millions) in the rolling 5-hour window. 0 = none.

weeklyTokensM.title: Subscription: weekly budget (M tokens)
weeklyTokensM.description: Subscription mode: weighted tokens (millions) in the rolling 7 days. 0 = none.

overBudget.title: Over budget
overBudget.description: warn: just say so; block: refuse new prompts until /frugal allow.

expensiveTurn.title: Expensive turn threshold (USD)
expensiveTurn.description: A toast after any turn that cost more than this. 0 = off.

fun.title: Fun mode
fun.description: Mood emoji, the mascot, quips and what your spend would have bought.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: frugalitas: English, Old Penny, USD; fukarlec: Hungarian, Fukar bácsi, HUF. /frugal mode switches it live.

hufRate.title: USD/HUF rate
hufRate.description: Fukarléc mode: for what your spend would have bought, in forints.
